change: Transaction-local key indexes only for collections whose keys are all direct scalar member reads. Nested map keyed by root collection path/member path; no stored cross-sync cache. Clear after each model write.
regressions: Key-changing write creates duplicate: subsequent binding refuses and atomic transaction rolls back.
Distinct outer local key scopes remain uncached.
Mixed computed/plain keys, exact dotted field priority, reorder/remove and error recovery all pass.
limitations: Allocation reduction is measured; release latency/FPS/peak memory are not qualified.
Earlier general scope cache was rejected; this narrower index does not clone contexts or retain cross-sync state.
Complex keys and frequent writes still rescan; worst-case quadratic behavior remains.
